lines.zh: 我踏过灵魂沙峡谷的沙。
lines.en: I stride across the soul sand valley.
My prints are deep and slow.

lines.zh: 我的长腿一步跨得很远。
lines.en: My long legs cover a lot of ground.
Ash settles on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我这双长爪，专挖硬东西。
lines.en: These long claws dig through anything hard.

lines.zh: 我的影子被火光拉得很长。
lines.en: The firelight stretches my shadow.
I pass a pillar of bone.

lines.zh: 我不急，这里没有别的事。
lines.en: No hurry; there is nothing else here.
My breath carries sparks.

lines.zh: 我弯下三格高的身子，穿过灰雾。
lines.en: I stoop my three-block frame through the ash haze.

lines.zh: 长腿迈一步，灰地就陷一块。
lines.en: Each stride of my long legs sinks the ash underfoot.
I stop at the edge of an ash pit.
I stand in the ash without moving.
My bone plates clack.
Firelight plays on my face.

lines.zh: 我举起长爪，看灰从指间落下。
lines.en: I raise a long claw and watch ash sift through it.
Soul sand here swallows feet.
Ash drifts into my eyes.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处的火光，眼也不动。
lines.en: I stare at the distant fire and my eyes do not move.
Soul sand burns my feet, and still I walk.

lines.zh: 我俯下身，骨甲咔咔作响。
lines.en: I bend down and my bone plates rattle.

lines.zh: 峡谷的灰里，不该有你的脚印。
lines.en: Your prints have no business in this valley's ash.
This valley is not yours.
I am much taller than you.

lines.zh: 下界荒地的骨头，都归我踩。
lines.en: Every bone in the Nether wastes is mine to tread.
My bone plates rattle.

lines.zh: 你呼出的热气，在灰里很醒目。
lines.en: The warm breath you exhale stands out in the ash.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷的风，从我肋骨间过。
lines.en: Soul sand wind passes through my ribs.

lines.zh: 血味顺着骨柱间的风过来。
lines.en: The smell of blood comes on the wind between the bone pillars.

lines.zh: 我捂着裂开的骨甲，退了半步。
lines.en: I clutch my split bone plate and give half a step.
A crack runs through my plates.
I lower my body.
My blood is black.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙在我脚下陷得很深。
lines.en: Soul sand sinks deep under my feet.
This wound is nothing.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷，我拿着挖眼的手。
lines.en: In the Soul Sand Valley, my hands dig.
I will return it.
There is nothing to eat here.

lines.zh: 你手里那块东西，我不认得。
lines.en: That thing in your hand, I do not recognize it.

lines.zh: 我不吃你递来的任何东西。
lines.en: I eat nothing that you hand me.
I knock it into the ash.
You are stalling.

lines.zh: 我瞥了一眼，又看向你的喉咙。
lines.en: One glance at it, then my eyes go to your throat.
That will not work.
You hold it yourself.
I do not eat what the dead offer.
You bumped my leg, steady yourself.
I barely feel it.
My bone plates are hard.
I lift a foot over you.
A bone pillar rings with the impact.
I sway and steady.
The ash gives way under your foot.

lines.zh: 我低头，影子把你整个盖住。
lines.en: I lower my head and my shadow swallows you whole.

lines.zh: 我跨过你，骨甲擦着你的头。
lines.en: I step over you, bone plates grazing your head.

lines.zh: 骨柱之间没有别的影子。
lines.en: No other shadow among the pillars.
I have stood alone a long while.
I look up at that sky.
The ash keeps falling.
The distant wailing stops.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷的风，刮得我耳朵疼。
lines.en: Soul-sand wind stings my ears.
This place needs no more.

lines.zh: 我独自站在骨柱之间，等灰落下。
lines.en: I stand alone among the bone pillars, waiting for ash to settle.
I bend to pick it up, nails feeling first.
Things in the ash have dried.
I hold it in my grip.

lines.zh: 我捏起来，灰从指缝漏掉。
lines.en: I pinch it up and ash leaks between my fingers.
I look and tuck it between my plates.
This is worth little.
You dropped it; it is mine.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我一用力就碎。
lines.en: One squeeze is all it takes to crush this thing.
The ash covers it again.
You stepped into my valley.
My hand comes up.
My bone plates clatter.
You retreat toward the pillars.
I am waiting there.
There is no path for you.

lines.zh: 我抬起长爪，指甲对着你。
lines.en: I raise a long claw, its nail pointed at you.

lines.zh: 我的第一步踩碎了焦骨。
lines.en: My first step crushes a charred bone.
The ash will be stained by your blood.
The valley is this narrow; you cannot run.

lines.zh: 我的步子太大，你逃不掉。
lines.en: My strides are too long for you.
I weave between the pillars.
When you look back, I am far off.
When you look again, I am closer.
The ash covers my prints.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷，三格高的影。
lines.en: A three-block shadow in the soul sand valley.
Look again, and I am a step closer.
I extend my nails.
You have backed toward the lava.
There is no farther path.

lines.zh: 我把身子横过来，灵魂沙的峡谷很窄。
lines.en: I turn sideways; the soul sand canyon is narrow.

lines.zh: 你听见骨甲的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the bone plates?
My bone plates crash into you.
I seize your shoulder.
I drag you across the ash.
You cannot stop this one.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙谷的风，吹不动我。
lines.en: The Soul Sand Valley wind can't shift me.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖挑开你的护肩。
lines.en: My claw tip pries open your shoulder guard.
I press down on your chest.
The ash rises.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷的风，我闻惯了。
lines.en: I know the soul sand valley wind.

lines.zh: 灰里站起来一个高个子。
lines.en: A tall figure rises out of the ash.
I appear from behind a bone pillar.
Firelight dances on me.
My bone plates close one by one.
The air here grows closer.
I straighten slowly.
I look down at the valley.
I lift a foot and ash sifts off.
Wailing comes from far off.

lines.zh: 火对我没什么用，这里到处都是火。
lines.en: Fire does little to me; it is everywhere here.

lines.zh: 我从骨柱上掉下来，砸碎了灰地。
lines.en: I fall from a bone pillar and break the ash crust.

lines.zh: 熔岩湖里我挣不出，皮在烧。
lines.en: I cannot climb from the lava lake, my hide burning.
The blast slams me into a pillar.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的骨缝里。
lines.en: An arrow wedges between my plates.
Spell-light bursts against me.
There is nothing living in this valley.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，把灰打成一团。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the ash clumps.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有灰，也没有火。
lines.en: No ash and no fire in the void.
